newsitem.title: USA: Ramsey family say brother should not be a suspect.
newsitem.headline: Ramsey family say brother should not be a suspect.

text.p: The older, half-brother of JonBenet Ramsey should not be considered a suspect in the girl's death, a spokesman for the parents said Monday.
Last week Boulder County District Attorney Alex Hunter said detectives were looking into the alibi of John Andrew Ramsey, 20, who attends college in Colorado.

Family spokesman Pat Korten said John Andrew was in Atlanta in the days before the murder and was enroute to Michigan to meet the family on Dec. 26 when he was notified the 6-year-old beauty pageant winner had been killed.
Korten said Boulder police were furnished with copies of the plane ticket and been given the names of witnesses who support John Andrew's account.
The body of JonBenet was discovered in the basement of the family's home in Boulder the day after Christmas and some eight hours after her mother said she found a ransom note demanding $118,000.
No arrests have been made and no suspects named.
